messages:
mira: quick FYI I opened a PR that updates the staging overlay to point session-svc at the read-replica endpoint instead of primary. terraform plan looked clean locally but the release-gate job is failing on overlay validation. can someone check secrets/KMS wiring so the canary won't break? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/412

sam: @mira can you paste the overlay patch you changed? are we changing DB password or only endpoint?

mira: only endpoint. not rotating creds. snippet:```yaml
# overlays/staging/patch-db-endpoint.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: session-svc
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: session
        env:
        - name: DB_HOST
          value: "replica.cluster-abcd.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
```
and terraform portion:```hcl
resource "aws_db_instance" "replica" {
  identifier           = "redwood-replica"
  replicate_source_db  = aws_db_instance.primary.id
  kms_key_id           = var.db_kms_key
}
```

toni: quick check — the staging KMS key is the same key id as before? if the EKS sa role doesn't have decrypt permission we'll 503 on DB creds. I looked: var.db_kms_key -> arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. that key policy allows the cluster role, but not the serviceaccount role we use for external-secrets. need to add kms:Decrypt to the IRSA policy.

alex: gating job error: `overlay-schema-lint` failing with `missing required env DB_HOST in kustomized deployment`. looks like the generator that populates DB_HOST from external secret is not wired in staging overlay. Did you add a literal env var instead of the secretRef?

mira: ah yeah I quick-patched literal for smoke test. bad call. i'll revert to secretRef and update external-secrets manifest. pushing fix now.

sam: nice — once you switch to `secretRef` the overlay-schema-lint should pass. also pinging @toni for the KMS change. can you open a tiny terraform change for the IAM policy?

toni: will do. I'll add this to infra-iam/irsa-staging.tf:```hcl
resource "aws_iam_policy_attachment" "staging_external_secrets_kms" {
  name       = "staging-external-secrets-kms"
  roles      = [aws_iam_role.external_secrets.name]
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.external_secrets_kms.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "external_secrets_kms" {
  name = "staging-external-secrets-kms"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Action = ["kms:Decrypt"],
      Effect = "Allow",
      Resource = var.db_kms_key
    }]
  })
}
```

deploy-bot: canary-gate run started for commit 8f3a2d7. checks: schema-lint, infra-plan, smoke-tests. current status: schema-lint FAILED. logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/9001

mira: pushed fix to use external secretRef and updated PR. requesting rerun of gating. @sam please review infra diff when you have a sec.

sam: on it, will review in ~30m. if infra-plan shows only IAM policy and no DB drift i'm fine to approve. :thumbsup:

toni: opened a tiny PR for the IRSA/KMS grant: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/415 — added note to rollout doc about granting kms:Decrypt to SA.

alex: note for rollback plan: if the canary fails after applying, revert the overlay commit and run `./hack/apply-overlay.sh staging --sync` then `terraform apply -var-file=staging.tfvars -target=aws_iam_policy.external_secrets_kms` to remove the IAM change if needed. keep DB primary untouched.

mira: perfect, thanks all. I'll queue the rerun and mark you both for review.

sam: approved infra diff after CI green.

toni: will merge IRSA PR once staging smoke-tests pass.

deploy-bot: canary-gate rerun started. status: pending -> schema-lint PASS -> infra-plan PASS -> smoke-tests running.

mira: merging once smoke-tests finish. will watch canary and post back if any anomalies. :eyes:

alex: thanks — good async flow.

mira: done — merged and canary progressing, no errors so far. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
